protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-770 DoS. GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p is GitHub-reviewed, withdrawn_at=null; CVE.org CVE-2026-42570 state=PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected). Source: devalue.parse(serialized) JSON.parse's attacker-controlled text then unflatten(). Sink: unflatten SPARSE branch treats value[0]===-7 as [-7, length, idx, val, ...] and executes new Array(len) with untrusted length. On V8, many small SPARSE entries with large declared lengths eagerly allocate contiguous backing stores far beyond payload size and exhaust memory. Fix 206ca6712fbc380a4571c59de9ab04b91110792d documents this in src/parse.js and adds ~20GB implied-allocation regression tests in test/index.test.js.
